answer: Shell reported 4 fatalities in 2025 and 2 in 2024. Fatality and permanent impairment (FPI) was 8 in both years; FPI frequency was 2.1 per 100 million hours in 2025 and 1.7 in 2024. Shell states that the 2024 figures were revised from 7 to 8 FPIs and from 1.5 to 1.7 cases per 100 million hours.

evidence.quote: Revised from 7 FPIs to 8 FPIs and resulting FPI-F from 1.5 cases per 100 million hours to 1.7 cases per 100 million hours for 2024.
